correctness.rationale: Read RESULT.md, proof and full tree_cut_verify.py. The clique complex of K_m □ T consists of t contractible column simplices plus m parallel edges over each tree edge; tree incidence has an integral right inverse, yielding H^1= (Z^m/Zdiag)⊗Z[E(T)]. A tree automorphism changes all bipartition-oriented edges by the common sign χ_T; ambient Alexander duality contributes ε=sign(σ)^t sign(a)^m. This proves integral H_{mt-4}=εχ_T⊗U_m⊗P_T with all other reduced groups zero, including mt=4 degree zero. The non-split exact sequence has order m: invariant Hom restriction Z→Z multiplies by m, the explicit equivariant lift s([z])=mz−sum(z)diag proves the upper bound, and restriction to S_m and projection to one tree edge proves lower bound. Independent small-face Euler enumerations matched three boundary cases; source verifies 192 signed traces on 10 trees.
